description: Wyman's Ultimate Edition commission: track down abandoned classic and work-in-progress project cars and their parts around Leonida, then have mechanic Wyman restore them into drivable vehicles.

description: Fifty UFO-themed novelty parts scattered across San Andreas in GTA V; press coverage expects a similar find-the-pieces set in GTA 6.

name: Letter Scraps
description: Fifty scattered paper pieces that assemble into a killer's letters in GTA V; press coverage expects a similar novelty collectible in GTA 6.

description: Fifty marked ramps to launch a vehicle from for a checklist reward in GTA V; press coverage expects stunt jumps to return in GTA 6.

name: Time Trials
description: A set of timed vehicle and stunt-plane courses in GTA V, an optional extra not required for 100% completion; press coverage expects time trials to return in GTA 6.

description: One hundred hidden packages shaped like tiki statues in GTA Vice City, with a reward for every ten found and all of them needed for 100% completion. Press coverage expects hidden packages in GTA 6.

description: Hidden caches of cash on the sea floor, found with a submarine's sonar in GTA Online. Previews say scuba diving in GTA 6 lets you search for treasure, including in shipwrecks.
